description.value: A full-service liquor store on Salt Spring Island operated under the Voyage Liquor brand, part of a locally owned Vancouver Island and Salt Spring Island chain serving communities since 2006. The location also functions as a Canada Post partner outlet, making it a useful stop for cyclists needing to ship or receive packages. Same-day delivery is available for orders placed online.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for uppergangesliquorstore.com redirects to Voyage Liquor, a multi-location chain; the Ganges location at 378 Lower Ganges Rd with phone 250-537-8699 matches the OSM record exactly, confirming the business is real and open. The OSM name 'Upper Ganges Liquor Store' does not match the current brand 'Voyage Liquor', which is a notable discrepancy to flag. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenity.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Upper Ganges Liquor Store' but the business currently operates under the brand 'Voyage Liquor'; the website makes no reference to 'Upper Ganges Liquor Store'.
A second Voyage Liquor location ('Ganges Express') exists at 133 Lower Ganges Rd on the same street — verify there is no duplicate OSM record for that address.
OSM community field lists 'Chemainus' but the business is on Salt Spring Island (SSI), not Chemainus — likely a data-entry error in the OSM community assignment.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible liquor store confirmed by active website listing 378 Lower Ganges Rd with matching phone number. Also serves as a Canada Post partner, adding utility for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag post_office=post_partner indicates this location also acts as a Canada Post retail partner, which may be useful to note for touring cyclists needing postal services.

wow_evidence: locally owned Vancouver Island and Salt Spring Island chain serving communities since 2006... Canada Post partner outlet
